image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a grey whale's head and rostrum emerging vertically from deep blue ocean water. The whale's snout is pointed upwards, breaking the surface with significant splashing and white foam. The skin appears dark grey/black with lighter mottling and barnacle-like textures. The background is uniform blue water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows the ventral side (mouth/throat) or the very tip of the rostrum pointing up. The dorsal side where blowholes are located is facing away from the camera or submerged, making them impossible to verify.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin clearly exhibits the characteristic mottled pattern with white/grey speckles consistent with barnacle encrustation found on grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped tightly on the head/rostrum. The posterior back and dorsal region are completely outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior tip of the animal is visible. The full body shape cannot be assessed due to cropping and submersion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; the texture on the visible portion matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed or obscured by the angle and water splash. Baleen plates are internal structures not visible in this external view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located further back on the body and are not visible in this head-only crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The high-resolution texture on the snout shows roughness and bumpiness consistent with callosities/barnacles.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The splash and foam have a slightly 'smudged' or painterly quality rather than distinct droplet physics, typical of AI generation struggling with complex fluid dynamics, though not catastrophic.
The symmetry of the rostrum seems slightly uneven, with the left side appearing marginally more distorted than the right, possibly due to generation artifacts or extreme angle.
